Security modeling and efficient computat.title: Security modeling and efficient computation offloading for service workflow in mobile edge computing
Security modeling and efficient computat.key_insight: Security overhead is node-dependent and linearly/inversely proportional to secured data size, processor cores, and frequency—enabling schedulers to incorporate heterogeneous overhead into optimization.
Security modeling and efficient computat.method_signature: SEECO strategy: security overhead model + NP-hard problem formulation + GA-based coding for task order, location, and security service selection.

Seed Feature Maps-based CNN Models for L.key_insight: 仅学习一个种子特征图，通过非线性变换函数（随机超参数）生成其余特征图，超参数由随机种子保存和复现。
Seed Feature Maps-based CNN Models for L.method_signature: SineFM：每层仅需一个种子滤波器，其余特征图由正弦函数等非线性变换生成。

Service Science.title: Service Science

Towards Robust Trajectory Embedding for.method_signature: LH-plugin含Cosh双曲投影模块和动态融合距离模块的插件化框架
